debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), weak short-term technicals (death cross active, MACD false bullish, no volume confirmation, price below EMA_9/20), zero fundamental catalysts, and earnings event risk in 39 days make this a high-risk, low-conviction entry.
